<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">QST:=EXIST(C/REF(CADM,1)&gt;1.055,60);</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">QTP:=DYNAINFO(4)&gt;0;</font></font></font><br>

<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">DGF:=YZZT AND QST AND QTP AND QCYB;</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">BGH:=(NOT(DGF)||CODELIKE('688'));</font></font></font><br>

<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">首板N:=(COUNT(ZT,N)=1 AND ZT);</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">BADM:=V/700000000;</font></font></font><br>

<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">LKJ1:=2.5*MAX(BADM,DFQ);</font></font></font><br>

<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">LPO:=EMA(HGS,2);</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">ASXC:=0.24;</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">GAE:=C&gt;=REF(CADM,1);</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">LKJ:= IF(HGS&gt;ASXC AND LPO&gt;=0.005 AND GAE,1,0);</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">LKJX:=CROSS(LKJ,0.5) AND COUNT(LKJ&gt;0.5,10)=1;</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">QB:="KDJ.J"-REF("KDJ.J",1)&gt;30 AND C/REF(CADM,1)&gt;1.043 AND "MACD.MACD"&gt;0 AND "MACD.DEA"&gt;0;</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">LMB:=C/REF(CADM,1)&gt;1.048 AND C=H AND BETWEEN(FORCAST(V,4),0.2*FORCAST(V,12),2.1*FORCAST(V,12));</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">LQ:=FILTER(LMB,28)*100 AND L&gt;REF(CADM,1)*0.93;</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">BGAS:=QB OR LQ AND LKJX;</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">BADM1:=9;</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">BAMQGFQ:=10;</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">ASX:=C/REF(CADM,1)&gt;1+0.01*BADM1;</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">GBS:=EXIST(C/REF(CADM,1)&gt;1+0.01*BADM1,BAMQGFQ);</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">LQC:=C/REF(CADM,1)&gt;1+0.01*BADM1;</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">ACF:=IF(ASX+GBS+LQC=3,1,0);</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">LCQ:=(H-C)/(C-O)&lt; 0.33;</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">MQG:=(C/REF(CADM,1)-1)&gt;=0.0502 AND C&gt;REF(CADM,1) AND (O-L)/(C-O)&gt;=1.48 AND L&lt; REF(L,1) AND L&lt; REF(L,2);</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">BAJ:=(C/REF(CADM,1)-1)&gt;=0.08;</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">AA:=V&gt;REF(V,1)*1.9 AND C&gt;REF(CADM,1) AND C/REF(CADM,1)-1&gt;=0.049 AND LCQ;</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">NQG:=(C/REF(CADM,1)-1)&gt;=0.0502 AND C&gt;REF(CADM,1) AND V&gt;REF(V,1) AND V&gt;REF(V,1)*2.5 AND LCQ;</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">LCQB:=EMA(2.055*EMA(EMA(H,34),34)-EMA(EMA(L,34),34),5),COLORCYAN,LINETHICK2;</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">YDBGAS:=IF(FILTER(AA OR NQG OR MQG OR BAJ AND LCQB&gt;CADM,34),1,0) AND ACF;</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">LYQD:=BGAS OR YDBGAS;</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">P:=CROSS(LYQD,1),LYQD-LYQD*0.14 AND 首板N;</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">QUI:=H=C;A:=(C-REF(CADM,1))/REF(CADM,1)*100&gt;=0.93 AND QUI;</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">T:=BARSLAST(P);</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">DBJ:=T AND A AND T&lt;=1 AND C/REF(CADM,1)&gt;1.02 AND BGH;</font></font></font><br>

<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">ADM3:=EVERY(ADM2,ADM1) OR ADM1=1;</font></font></font><br>

<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">ADM12:=SMA(20*(ADM11/REF(ADM11,1)-1),2,1);</font></font></font><br>
<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">ADM13:=EMA(ADM12,2);</font></font></font><br>

<font style="color:rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.9)"><font face="&amp;quot"><font style="font-size:17px">ADM16:=IF(ADM12&gt;ADM14 AND ADM13&gt;=0.005 AND ADM15,1,0);</font></font></font><br>
